summary_en: FY3/27 dividend guidance raised to ¥112/share (from ¥92) via ¥20 commemorative final dividend. Interim unchanged at ¥32; ordinary final at ¥60. Payout ratio floor 40%+; progressive dividend policy with no-cut principle. Holding company transition effective October 2026.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Increase through Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: United Arrows revised its FY3/27 dividend forecast on 7 August 2026. The company raised the annual per-share dividend from ¥92 to ¥112 by introducing a ¥20 commemorative final dividend, in addition to the previously forecast ¥32 interim and ¥60 ordinary final dividends. The commemorative dividend marks the company's transition to a holding company structure effective 1 October 2026 (rebranding as TABAYA Holdings) and expresses gratitude to shareholders who have supported this transformation. The company restated its commitment to progressive dividend policy with a minimum 40% payout ratio and a no-cut principle. Future shareholder returns will also employ stock splits, buybacks, and share cancellation alongside dividend growth to maximize shareholder value while funding sustainable expansion into non-apparel sectors.
